scope: Development observability, not clinical and not a controller. Keep current scene, mechanics, budgets, old reader and signed gates unchanged. Never substitute oracle coordinates for decoded coordinates to drive a motion.
unit: The scored central material cell has TWO opaque triangle faces. A ray lying strictly inside a possible face and seeing real depth >2 mm behind its entire depth range is positive evidence that this face is absent. Both faces must be positively absent in every preceding cell, including both faces of cell index 8 for a STOP. A positively identified, still-present face at the front and in the following material cell proves intact material ahead. Absence of ink is never evidence that a face is absent. Missing/contradictory data, an unbounded corner, disjoint separation, an intact bridge followed by an open cell, or >10 open cells refuse. Rows count from zero; do not count ordinal crossing lines.
image_evidence: Use current RGB-D only. Require a 2x2 block of finite far depth behind each material triangle, not four scattered or diagonal pixels. A pixel centre must be inside every edge by at least sqrt(0.5) pixels (the whole pixel footprint) plus the certified projected error of its optical corners. For depth comparisons use the farthest possible vertex, not the mean plane. Simulated imaging and RGB inks are not perfectly calibrated physical measurements. Noise stress is deterministic 0.5 mm Gaussian, not a guaranteed bound on real noise.
ceiling: First use only archived real 4x full images at 70 deg in seam_slide_v2, for all mechanical runs and all phases. For scorer-only visibility grant exact corner projections, exact vertex depths, perfect knowledge of positive tissue presence when a face survives, and no ink or end decoding needed. That is optimistic: failure excludes only this sufficient predicate at this observation; success is NOT a visual result. Report the 0-px and 1-px corner uncertainty cases. Preserve whole-face footprint and connected-pixel requirement even on synthetic images. No confirmation, threshold tuning or controller integration based on a ceiling.
synthetic: Blind image certificate must distinguish 8 fully open, 8 plus either half of cell 8 missing, 9 fully open, and 10 fully open. An interior surviving triangle followed by completely cut cells, intact loaded, shutter and a foreground cover blocking all evidence of a target face must return UNKNOWN. Repeat with 0.5 mm depth noise. No row/face labels, truth lengths or action counts supplied to an image reader. Negative-control success does not count as completion.
corner_contract: Each material node in columns 11 and 12 has a unique corner-cap ink only ON adjacent real bank triangles. Its 15% barycentric cap is within 0.15 * sqrt(2) * 1.5 mm of the vertex while its host edges survive (nominal pitch 1 mm, tear ratio 1.5). Bound the corner projection by intersecting intervals from its decoded pixels, using the calibrated focal length, measured optical depth, a half-pixel sampling allowance, 0.25 mm range allowance plus 3 sigma in noise. No assumption that the centroid is the vertex. Never synthesize a cap on a missing face. Require a minimum 4-connected-pixel ink patch, observed ends and strictly ordered material row positions on both banks. The reader also requires a single observed 4-connected deep gap linking the certified blocks, restricted to supported row windows. A missing cap or mesh primitive is not itself a stop signal. The privileged ceiling may omit connectivity and grant positive intact tissue only to DISQUALIFY, not qualify.
physical_screen: If the old working surface cannot provide the predicate, test a separately fixed narrower physical sensor FOV of 30 degrees at 2560x1920 on the SAME registered working states a/b and their original guarded 3-mm post-closure observation. Exact old unaltered RGB-D, controller, material and pose must match. No movement of camera or PSM during exposures. Test immutable vertex caps on the adjacent surviving side-face material and permanent per-face inks, preserving all physical triangles, forces and cuts. Scores at work and post-backoff remain separate. Do not accept an observation after parking in place of work.
pass: The synthetic cases are mandatory. All actual working 8-mm frames must explicitly say BELOW, all working 9/10-mm frames STOP at raw and noisy depth, no wrong authorization on any development sample, uncut and shutter UNKNOWN. An exploratory matched pair alone cannot qualify this. Do not spend independent confirmation or change visual control on a failed development gate.
